title: Process Forge Direct Injection images to square PNGs before Pinata upload

requirements.summary: Process Forge Direct Injection uploads into a square PNG at project.settings.outputSize with optional pixel-mode rendering before saving to project state.
acceptanceCriteria: When a user uploads a 1:1 image via Forge > Direct Injection, the resulting saved token imageData is a PNG data URL whose intrinsic pixel dimensions equal project.settings.outputSize x project.settings.outputSize.
If project.pixelArtMode is enabled, the processing step uses a canvas with imageSmoothingEnabled=false so the output is pixelated rather than anti-aliased.
The Forge gallery display continues to work and shows the processed image.

file_operations.description: Add a reusable image-processing helper that takes an uploaded image data URL, draws it onto a square canvas sized to project.settings.outputSize x project.settings.outputSize, disables canvas image smoothing when pixel mode is enabled, and returns a PNG data URL. Implement a non-distorting scale-and-crop (cover) strategy so inputs reliably become a square output.

Update Forge > Direct Injection flow to process uploads via the new forgeImageProcessing helper before adding items to the injection queue and before persisting forged tokens. Ensure the queue preview and the saved CustomToken.imageData use the processed PNG output, and that pixel mode toggles canvas smoothing behavior during processing.

requirements.summary: Do not persist any original, unprocessed Direct Injection image bytes or dimensions in long-lived project state.
acceptanceCriteria: After Direct Injection, project.customTokens contains only the processed (resized/pixel-mode) imageData for each injected token.
Refreshing/reloading the app does not restore any original (pre-processed) Direct Injection image variant because it was never persisted.

file_operations.description: Ensure Direct Injection never stores the original uploaded data URL into project.customTokens (or any other project state used for persistence/export). Only keep the processed PNG data URL when creating CustomToken entries, and avoid adding any extra fields that retain original file bytes/dimensions.

requirements.summary: Ensure the IPFS/Pinata upload pipeline uses processed Forge images by keeping project.generatedNFTs[*].imageData sourced from processed forged token imageData.
acceptanceCriteria: Uploading a collection to Pinata results in image files whose intrinsic pixel dimensions match project.settings.outputSize x project.settings.outputSize for Forge-upload-derived NFTs.
No Pinata-uploaded image for Forge-upload-derived NFTs retains the original uploaded pixel dimensions.

file_operations.description: Ensure all Forge Direct Injection CustomToken.imageData values are already processed, so when Vault generation includes forged tokens and populates project.generatedNFTs[*].imageData for those NFTs, the data flowing into Pinata upload is the processed output.

Add a lightweight guard/validation in the image preparation step to assert uploaded NFT imageData is a PNG data URL and optionally warn/throw if forged-token-derived images are missing or malformed, helping ensure the upload uses the processed imageData already stored in project/generatedNFTs.
